concept: CloudFront OAC: S3 origin access only through the CDN
tests: How to serve S3 content via CloudFront while blocking direct public access to the bucket.
expected: CloudFront Origin Access Control + a bucket policy allowing s3:GetObject only for that distribution (AWS:SourceArn). Triggers: "prevent direct public access to the S3 origin", "only through the CDN".
why_not: A public bucket or static website hosting exposes the origin; dropping CloudFront removes the CDN.
